scientific_integrity: The claimed contribution concerns the full prime-two orbit classification, its sharp growth-ratio boundary, the startup interval, and locally transverse collapse; the source method, convergence theorem, and reciprocal-square curvature-cap identity are credited to the original authors. Only self-review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar strongly convex quadratic only.
No universal characterization of basins or non-two-period dynamics.
Only exact arithmetic and finite nonzero iterate differences; no finite-precision robustness.
A structurally analogous theorem under other terminology might preexist.
title: A continuum of exactly alternating stepsizes in adaptive gradient descent-2
